title: Animals and Family — Level 10 — Final challenge

items.prompt: Which sentence about a hen is correct?

visual.text: A hen has a long trunk.

choices.say: A hen has a long trunk.

items.reteach: Ayam berkaki dua: A hen has two legs. Ayam memberi kita telur.

items.prompt: Dina's mother has a brother, Mr. Rudi. Which sentence is correct?
items.reteach: Saudara laki-laki ibu adalah paman: uncle.

items.prompt: Which animal name is spelled correctly?
items.reteach: Ejaannya e-l-e-p-h-a-n-t. Bunyi f ditulis ph.

items.prompt: "A cow has two horns and four wings." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Sapi tidak punya sayap. Seharusnya four legs.

items.prompt: Which sentence about mice is correct?
items.reteach: Satu mouse, banyak mice. Mice sudah bentuk jamak.

items.prompt: "A fish lives in the water and flies with its fins." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Ikan berenang dengan sirip: swims with its fins.

items.prompt: Rina has a brother, Tio, and a sister, Mila. Which sentence is correct?

visual.text: Tio and Mila are Rina's parents.

choices.say: Tio and Mila are Rina's parents.

items.reteach: Rina dan Mila sama-sama perempuan dan bersaudara: sisters. Tio adalah brother.

items.prompt: Which sentence about baby animals is correct?

visual.text: A kitten is a baby cat.

choices.say: A kitten is a baby cat.

visual.text: A puppy is a baby cow.

choices.say: A puppy is a baby cow.

visual.text: A calf is a baby dog.

choices.say: A calf is a baby dog.

visual.text: A chick is a baby duck.

choices.say: A chick is a baby duck.

items.reteach: Kitten = anak kucing. Puppy anak anjing, calf anak sapi, chick anak ayam.

items.prompt: "The giraffe has a short neck." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Leher jerapah panjang: The giraffe has a long neck.

items.prompt: Which sentence about penguins is correct?

visual.text: A penguin is a bird, but it cannot fly.

choices.say: A penguin is a bird, but it cannot fly.

visual.text: A penguin is a fish, and it can fly.

choices.say: A penguin is a fish, and it can fly.

visual.text: A penguin lives in a hot desert.

choices.say: A penguin lives in a hot desert.

items.reteach: Penguin adalah burung yang tidak bisa terbang, tetapi pandai berenang.

items.prompt: Pak Budi has two children, Sasa and Dodi. Which sentence is correct?
items.reteach: Pak Budi punya dua anak, jadi Pak Budi adalah ayah mereka: father.

items.prompt: "A snake has many legs." Kata mana yang kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Ular tidak berkaki: A snake has no legs.

items.prompt: How many people live in Nisa's house?

stimulus.text: Hi, I am Nisa. I live with my father, my mother, and my grandmother. I have a little brother, Fajar. He is four years old.

items.reteach: Nisa, father, mother, grandmother, dan Fajar: ada 5 orang.

items.prompt: Who is Fajar in Nisa's family?

stimulus.text: Hi, I am Nisa. I live with my father, my mother, and my grandmother. I have a little brother, Fajar. He is four years old.

items.reteach: Teksnya: I have a little brother, Fajar.

items.prompt: In Nisa's text, the word "He" means …

stimulus.text: Hi, I am Nisa. I live with my father, my mother, and my grandmother. I have a little brother, Fajar. He is four years old.

items.reteach: He is four years old: He menunjuk Fajar, adik Nisa.

items.prompt: What colour is Kiko's fur?

stimulus.text: Kiko is a rabbit. He has long ears and white fur. He eats carrots and green leaves. He lives in a hutch in the garden.

items.reteach: Teksnya: He has long ears and white fur.

items.prompt: Where does Kiko live?

stimulus.text: Kiko is a rabbit. He has long ears and white fur. He eats carrots and green leaves. He lives in a hutch in the garden.

visual.text: in a hutch in the garden

choices.say: in a hutch in the garden

visual.text: in a nest in a tree

choices.say: in a nest in a tree

items.reteach: He lives in a hutch in the garden. Hutch = kandang kelinci.

items.prompt: What does Kiko eat?

stimulus.text: Kiko is a rabbit. He has long ears and white fur. He eats carrots and green leaves. He lives in a hutch in the garden.

items.reteach: He eats carrots and green leaves.

items.prompt: How many baby goats are there at Grandpa's farm?
items.reteach: Baris goat, kolom Babies: 4 = four.

items.prompt: Which animal has no babies at Grandpa's farm?
items.reteach: Horse: Babies 0. Jadi kuda tidak punya anak di peternakan itu.

items.prompt: How many adult cows and adult horses are there at Grandpa's farm?
items.reteach: Adults: cow 3 + horse 2 = 5 = five.

items.prompt: Who is the youngest child in the Hadi family?

stimulus.text: Mr. and Mrs. Hadi have three children: Tika, Andi, and Lusi. Tika is the oldest. Lusi is the youngest.

items.reteach: Teksnya: Lusi is the youngest. Youngest = paling muda.

items.prompt: Andi is Lusi's …

stimulus.text: Mr. and Mrs. Hadi have three children: Tika, Andi, and Lusi. Tika is the oldest. Lusi is the youngest.

items.reteach: Andi dan Lusi punya ayah dan ibu yang sama. Andi laki-laki, jadi brother.

items.prompt: Mrs. Hadi is the children's …

stimulus.text: Mr. and Mrs. Hadi have three children: Tika, Andi, and Lusi. Tika is the oldest. Lusi is the youngest.

items.reteach: Mr. and Mrs. Hadi have three children. Mrs. Hadi adalah ibu mereka: mother.

items.prompt: At the zoo in Surabaya. Rani: "Look! That animal has black and white stripes." Dad: "It is a ___."
items.reteach: Zebra punya belang hitam putih: stripes.

items.prompt: Ali: "Who is that woman?" Dewi: "She is my aunt. She is my father's ___."
items.reteach: Bibi bisa saudara perempuan ayah: my father's sister.

items.prompt: Teacher: "Which animal gives us wool?" Bima: "A ___ does."
items.reteach: Wool (wol) berasal dari bulu domba: sheep.

items.prompt: Vet: "What pet do you have?" Sasa: "I have a ___. It says woof, woof."
items.reteach: Woof, woof adalah suara anjing: dog.

items.prompt: Grandpa in Madura: "Our cows are hungry." Toni: "I will give them some ___."
items.reteach: Sapi makan rumput: grass.

items.prompt: Dina: "This is my uncle's son." Lia: "Oh, he is your ___."
items.reteach: Anak paman adalah sepupu: cousin.

items.prompt: Mother: "Don't touch the bee! It can ___ you."
items.reteach: Lebah bisa menyengat: sting.

items.prompt: At the farm: "Moo, moo!" Toni: "I can hear a ___."
items.reteach: Moo adalah suara sapi: cow.

items.prompt: Ani: "Is your sister older than you?" Bobi: "Yes. She is ten and I am seven. She is my ___ sister."
items.reteach: Kakak berumur 10, Bobi 7. Kakak lebih tua: older sister.

items.prompt: Mother: "Your aunt's children are coming today." Lala: "Yay! My ___ are coming!"
items.reteach: Anak-anak bibi adalah sepupu: cousins.

items.prompt: Farmer: "The hen is sitting on her eggs." Soon, small ___ will come out.
items.reteach: Telur ayam menetas menjadi anak ayam: chicks.

items.prompt: Edo: "My cat has four babies!" Lisa: "Wow, four ___! Can I see them?"
items.reteach: Anak kucing = kitten, banyak = kittens.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: long / has / The / a / elephant / trunk

visual.text: The elephant has a long trunk.

choices.say: The elephant has a long trunk.

visual.text: The elephant has trunk a long.

choices.say: The elephant has trunk a long.

visual.text: Elephant the has a long trunk.

choices.say: Elephant the has a long trunk.

visual.text: The has elephant a long trunk.

choices.say: The has elephant a long trunk.

items.reteach: Pola: The elephant (siapa) + has (punya) + a long trunk (apa).

items.prompt: Arrange the words: my / is / This / grandmother
items.reteach: Pola: This is + my grandmother.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: can / Birds / fly / sky / the / in

visual.text: Birds can fly in the sky.

choices.say: Birds can fly in the sky.

visual.text: Birds fly can in the sky.

choices.say: Birds fly can in the sky.

visual.text: Can birds in the sky fly.

choices.say: Can birds in the sky fly.

visual.text: Birds can the sky fly in.

choices.say: Birds can the sky fly in.

items.reteach: Pola: Birds + can fly + in the sky.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: has / sister / My / cat / a / white

visual.text: My sister has a white cat.

choices.say: My sister has a white cat.

visual.text: Sister my has a white cat.

choices.say: Sister my has a white cat.

visual.text: My sister a white has cat.

choices.say: My sister a white has cat.

visual.text: My sister has a cat white.

choices.say: My sister has a cat white.

items.reteach: Kata sifat sebelum benda: a white cat.

items.prompt: Change into plural: one goose, two ___
items.reteach: Goose bentuk jamaknya geese.

items.prompt: Change into plural: one sheep, two ___
items.reteach: Sheep bentuk jamaknya tetap sheep.

items.prompt: Change "He is my brother." for a girl: "___ is my sister."
items.reteach: Untuk perempuan dipakai She.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: swims / The / in / duck / the / pond

visual.text: The duck swims in the pond.

choices.say: The duck swims in the pond.

visual.text: The duck in swims the pond.

choices.say: The duck in swims the pond.

visual.text: Swims the duck in the pond.

choices.say: Swims the duck in the pond.

visual.text: The duck the pond swims in.

choices.say: The duck the pond swims in.

items.reteach: Pola: The duck + swims + in the pond.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: are / They / my / cousins
items.reteach: Pola: They are + my cousins.

items.prompt: Change into plural: one wolf, two ___
items.reteach: Kata berakhiran f menjadi -ves: wolf menjadi wolves.

items.prompt: Change "I have a puppy." into "She ___ a puppy."
items.reteach: I have, tetapi she has.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: milk / gives / The / us / cow
items.reteach: Pola: The cow + gives + us + milk.

items.prompt: Riddle: I have a shell on my back. I walk very slowly. I am not a snail. What am I?
items.reteach: Tortoise (kura-kura darat) punya cangkang dan berjalan sangat pelan.

items.prompt: Riddle: I am black and white. I am a bird, but I cannot fly. I swim in cold water. What am I?
items.reteach: Penguin: burung hitam putih, tidak bisa terbang.

items.prompt: Puppy is to dog as cub is to …
items.reteach: Puppy anak anjing. Cub anak singa: lion.

items.prompt: Odd one out: kitten, puppy, calf, horse
items.reteach: Kitten, puppy, calf adalah anak hewan. Horse hewan dewasa.

items.prompt: Bimo's father has a brother, Rudi. Rudi has a son, Edo. Edo is Bimo's …
items.reteach: Rudi adalah paman Bimo. Anak paman adalah sepupu: cousin.

items.prompt: Letter code: A = 1, B = 2, C = 3 … T = 20. Which animal is 3-1-20?
items.reteach: 3 = C, 1 = A, 20 = T. Jadi CAT.

items.prompt: Odd one out: aunt, mother, sister, uncle
items.reteach: Aunt, mother, sister perempuan. Uncle laki-laki.

items.prompt: Riddle: I am the son of your aunt and uncle. Who am I?
items.reteach: Anak bibi dan paman adalah sepupu: cousin.

items.prompt: Riddle: I have a long neck and long legs. I eat leaves from tall trees. What am I?
items.reteach: Giraffe (jerapah) berleher panjang.

items.prompt: Ani is older than Budi. Budi is older than Cici. Who is the youngest?
items.reteach: Ani paling tua, lalu Budi, lalu Cici. Cici paling muda.

items.prompt: Odd one out: duck, hen, goose, goat
items.reteach: Duck, hen, goose adalah unggas berkaki dua. Goat berkaki empat.

items.prompt: Grandma has two sons. Each son has three children. How many grandchildren does Grandma have?
items.reteach: 3 + 3 = 6 cucu = six grandchildren.
